transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m just… not sleeping right. I get off my overnight shift and I’ll be exhausted, but I still lie there wide awake. Then if I do fall asleep, I wake up scared and it feels like I didn’t rest at all.
Do you think your overnight shift is affecting your sleep pattern?
I don’t know… maybe. I mean, I get off the overnight shift exhausted, but then I still just lie there awake. And if I do sleep, I wake up scared, like I didn’t really rest.
Do you have trouble sleeping on your days off as well?
Yeah… even on days off, it’s still messed up. I’ll be exhausted and just lie there awake, and if I do drift off, I wake up scared… like I didn’t sleep at all.
Do you experience any physical sensations, like pain or tension, when you wake up scared?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to pain or anything. I just wake up scared and tense, I guess… but I’m not sure.
Do you have bad dreams when you wake up scared?
I don’t really know if it’s dreams. I just… I finally drift off and then wake up scared, like I didn’t rest at all. My sleep’s just broken up.
Do you have any memories of dreaming when you wake up scared?
Not really… I don’t remember dreams. I just drift off for a little bit and then wake up scared, like I didn’t sleep at all.
Do you feel anxious or stressed when you're lying awake at night?
Yeah… I guess I do. After I get off my overnight shift, I’ll lie there wide awake, and I just can’t settle. Then if I do fall asleep, I wake up scared and it feels like I didn’t rest at all.
Is your anxiety present during the day as well, not just when you're trying to sleep?
I’m not really sure… I don’t pay attention to it like that during the day. It’s worse when I’m trying to sleep, I think.
Do you feel anxious during the day when you're not trying to sleep?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes, but I don’t really notice it much during the day. It’s mostly when I’m trying to sleep.
Do you think your anxiety is what's keeping you awake at night?
Maybe… I don’t know if it’s the anxiety exactly. I just know after my overnight shift, I’m wide awake, and then when I finally do sleep I wake up scared. It doesn’t feel like I rested.
Is anxiety something you experience most of the time, not just when trying to sleep?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it being most of the time… it just kind of hits me more when I’m trying to sleep.
Do you feel anxious most of the time, even when you're not trying to sleep?
I’m not really sure… I don’t think it’s most of the time. I just don’t pay attention to it much unless I’m trying to sleep.
Do you feel anxious even on a typical day when nothing out of the ordinary is happening?
I don’t know… on a normal day I’m mostly just trying to get through it. I don’t really notice anxiety unless something makes me think about it.
Do you feel anxious even when nothing is worrying you or stressing you out?
I’m not sure… I don’t really notice it when there isn’t something on my mind. It’s hard to tell.
Do you feel anxious most of the day, every day?
I don’t think so… not most of the day, every day. I just don’t really keep track of it like that.
Do you feel anxious even when everything in your life is going well?
I don’t really know. I guess I don’t think about it that way… when things are going okay, I’m just kind of there. I haven’t noticed feeling anxious for no reason.
Do you feel anxious even when everything in your life is going well and there's no apparent reason to be anxious?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed feeling anxious when there’s no reason. I guess I’m not sure.
Do you feel anxious most of the time, even when there's nothing in particular worrying you?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think it’s most of the time. I just don’t pay that much attention to it, I guess.
Do you feel anxious most of the day?
I don’t think so… not most of the day. I guess I just don’t really notice it like that.
Is anxiety the main thing that's been bothering you lately?
No… I don’t think anxiety is the main thing. I mean, I get uneasy sometimes, but… that’s not really what’s been bothering me most.
